issues.description: PersonService method name mismatch: the problem statement and template require a method named addParent(Person person, Person parent) (students are instructed to implement addParent). The template declares public Person addParent(Person person, Person parent) as a TODO. The solution repository implements the same functionality under the name registerParent(Person person, Person parent) instead of addParent. Call sites (PersonResource REST controller and unit tests) invoke addParent(...). This naming divergence means the expected method name (addParent) and the implemented method name (registerParent) do not match, which will cause confusion and compilation errors when controllers/tests reference addParent but the service only exposes registerParent.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Rename the solution method registerParent(Person, Person) to addParent(Person, Person), or add a public addParent(Person person, Person parent) method that delegates to registerParent. Ensure the signature exactly matches the template/problem-statement expectation so controllers and tests that call addParent(...) compile and run without modification.
